title: HB614 (2019 Regular): Firearms; prohibit altering serial number.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2019/html/HB/0600-0699/HB0614IN.htm)
provenance.note: No passage vote on record; text read is the bill as filed.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section): A person shall not knowingly buy, sell, ship, transport, pawn, receive, or possess any stolen firearm or any firearm from which the manufacturer's serial number has been altered, obliterated or removed.
Section 1 (new section): A person shall not knowingly alter, obliterate or remove the manufacturer's serial number of a firearm.
Section 1 (new section): A person violating the provisions of this section where a death does not occur shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction, shall be fined not more than Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) or imprisoned not more than one (1) year, or both.
Section 1 (new section): A person violating the provisions of this section where a death occurs shall be guilty of a felony and, upon conviction, shall be fined not more than Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($500,000.00) or imprisoned not more than ten (10) years, or both.
